content.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: Starting at 5th level, when an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

content.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to halve the attack's damage against you (round down).
